about: Synthetic listings and hirer sentences for the Curated tier-2 floor (recall.ts TIER2_FLOOR): what a listing that misses the token gate scores against a sentence, by relation. Invented; no real person, company or place beyond a city name. A listing's text is what the phone embeds as the listing's document (listingText without the English names): its titles joined by '; ', then its skills, then its certificates, the parts joined by '. '. A sentence names which listings are right (the occupation it asks for, in any language), near (an adjacent occupation a hirer would still want to see as tier 2) and industry (the same industry, another occupation: never a finalist). Every other listing is far. A listing in Portuguese or Spanish also carries `english`: the registry's English names for its claims, which the plane's own embed appends in brackets (listingText) and the phone's does not.
